feeds.title: Dutch Tech Magazine
feeds.description: Dutch-Tech.nl is the tech blog magazine! The Magazine features News, reviews, tips, and research about tech! including Apple, Android, Microsoft, Telecom, Games, Gadgets, and more!

feeds.title: Dutch Technology eXperts
feeds.description: Dutch Technology eXperts, or DTX, has been around for 24 years and is an expert in technological issues. We like to make managed services around infrastructure and information security clear and understandable. We ensure that entrepreneurs do not have to worry about this subject so that they can focus on doing business. Our blog is an ideal place to find articles about our company, the latest technology news, updates, feature stories, DTX technology, and more.

feeds.title: Holland Innovative Blog
feeds.description: Get more insights into what Holland Innovative's experts have to say to stay on top. Read more about it on the HI Blog. Holland Innovative is a project agency for project management, reliability engineering, problem-solving, data analysis, and medical product development. They execute projects for large multinationals, SMEs and tech start-ups.

feeds.title: Netherlands Innovation Network
feeds.description: Netherlands Innovation Network ('Innovatie Attaché Netwerk' in Dutch) is part of the Dutch Ministry of Economic Affairs that operates in multiple countries with a strong innovation capacity and/or potential. This network aims to improve the innovation capabilities of the Netherlands by linking global and Dutch innovation networks. Follow their blog which features various useful articles about the dutch ministry affairs, technology updates, the latest news and more.

feeds.title: Silicon Canals
feeds.description: Silicon Canals blog is Benelux and Europe's leading English language technology media source. We cover news, knowledge, and insights from the European technology and startup ecosystem, providing a growing number of startup CEOs, technology scale-up founders, angel investors, venture capitalists, innovation managers, and other interested parties from the tech and startup community with invaluable and indispensable information.

feeds.title: Dutch Techcentre for Life Sciences
feeds.description: The Dutch Techcentre for Life Sciences (DTL) is a public-private partnership of more than 50 life science organizations in the Netherlands. The majority of Dutch universities and university medical centers are DTL partners and a growing number of companies are joining the organization. DTL is organized as a network of experts and policymakers affiliated with the partners. Follow their blog which features technological data, health sector, AI, the latest news and updates.

feeds.title: Holland FinTech
feeds.description: Since 2014, we've provided access to knowledge, a network, investments, and talent to +300 companies. We connect people and organizations in the financial value chain, enabling consumers and businesses to profit from innovation and development. Read All Analyses, Company Announcements, Events, News, Event Recap, Fintech News, Funding News, and more on BlogHF.

feeds.title: Quantum Delta NL
feeds.description: Are you curious about what Quantum Delta NL can offer you? If you are an entrepreneur looking for the best location to grow your business, a scientist who wishes to contribute to developments, or a private partner seeking to conduct research together, we can connect you to the right hub or person. Learn more about our company nd our services through our informative blog.

feeds.title: Netherlands Maritime Technology
feeds.description: Netherlands Maritime Technology is a close-knit & successful network of and shipyards, maritime suppliers, and service providers. Their blog shares articles on various topics such as shipping business, events, shipping companies, annual meetings, and more related subjects.
